D/ IMP C CARAVSIVS P AVG ; R/ PAX AVGGG

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Carausius (286-293), in very fine condition, C mint PAX AVGGG conciliatory issue, RIC vol. 5, part 2, page 493 no. 335. Obverse description: Long-necked and bull-necked radiate bust draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C CARAVSIVS P AVG. Reverse description: Pax standing left holding sprig and vertical sceptre, S | P in field. Reverse inscription: PAX AVGGG. In exergue: C. Diameter: 22.1mm, Weight: 4.78gms, die axis: 6
